input: I have a project deadline on the 30th. I need to schedule a kickoff meeting with the engineering team, a design review with the UX team, and a final sign-off with the stakeholders. Can you create all three tasks and set reminders three days before each one?
Last week I asked you to follow up with three clients: Acme Corp, Bright Solutions, and TechStart. Can you check the status of all three follow-up tasks and tell me which ones are still open?

I need to reorganize my project board. Move all tasks tagged 'Q1' that are not yet started into a new list called 'Q2 Backlog', and close any tasks that have been open for more than 90 days without any updates.

I have a recurring weekly standup every Monday at 9am with the product team, but starting next month I want to shift it to Tuesday at 10am and add two new participants: the design lead and the QA manager. Can you update all future occurrences?

My manager just asked for a status update on the 'Platform Migration' project. Can you summarize all tasks under that project, highlight which ones are blocked, and draft a short status message I can send in Slack?
I need to prepare for my performance review next week. Please gather all the tasks I completed in the last three months, group them by project, and list any that were delivered ahead of schedule.

The sprint planning meeting is tomorrow and I need to have the backlog groomed before then. Can you list all unestimated tasks in the 'Backend Improvements' project, sort them by creation date, and flag the ones that have been waiting more than two weeks?

I just got out of a meeting where we decided to deprioritize the 'Mobile App' feature set for the next two sprints. Can you move all associated tasks to the 'Parked' column, notify the mobile team lead by adding a comment, and set the project status to 'On Hold'?
